Links use reference-style formatting

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"link_style\":\"Reference\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><a href='https://example.com'>Example</a> and <a href='https://other.com'>Other</a></p>", options)
```
